stem:
Kunal sets up pots of bean seeds in moist aerated soil, dry soil, and waterlogged soil. Some pots are kept in the dark and some in sunlight.

In which case should the bean seeds germinate?

options.text: In waterlogged soil in sunlight, with almost no air spaces.
In moist, aerated soil kept in the dark.
In dry soil with plenty of air and bright light.
They will not germinate in moist, aerated soil in the dark, because beans need light to sprout.

teacher.key_rationale: Bean seeds need moisture and air. Light is not required for germination.
